about: The cases every initializer of the family executes, so that each prints the same verdict for the same destination, git state and flags. Each suite runs its initializer with a stub make that records its arguments and exits with make_exit, a PATH holding that stub and the real git, a git configuration of its own, and PIPELEX_API_KEY set unless key is false.

legend.destination: What stands at the destination before the run. missing: nothing; empty: an empty directory; git-without-commit: a directory holding only the .git of git init; git-with-history: a directory holding only the .git of a repository with a commit, its files deleted; git-with-staged-file: a directory holding only the .git of git init whose index holds notes.txt, added and then deleted from the directory; ds-store: a directory holding .DS_Store; user-file: a directory holding notes.txt; beneath-a-file: the destination is typed as notes.txt/my-app, notes.txt being a file, so nothing can stand there.
legend.spelled: How the destination is typed. name: my-app, from its parent; space: my app, from its parent; dot: ., from inside it (the destination must exist); absent: no directory at all.
legend.within: Where the destination's parent is. nothing: a directory no repository tracks; work-tree: inside the work tree of a repository with a commit and an origin of its own; template-checkout: inside the work tree of a repository whose origin is https://github.com/Pipelex/pipelex-method-apps.git; ignored-parent: under the tmp/ directory of a repository as in work-tree, whose committed .gitignore holds tmp/; ignored-by-name: at the root of a repository as in work-tree, whose committed .gitignore holds the directory-only pattern my-app/, which matches the destination only when it is read as a directory; re-included: under the apps/ directory of a repository as in work-tree, whose committed .gitignore holds apps/* and then !apps/my-app/, so that the destination itself is not ignored when it is read as a directory; ignores-everything: at the root of a repository as in work-tree, whose committed .gitignore holds *, as a home directory kept as a repository often does; ignores-files-only: at the root of a repository as in work-tree, whose committed .gitignore holds * and then !*/, which ignores every file but no directory; contents-ignored: at the root of a repository as in work-tree, whose committed .gitignore holds my-app/* and then !my-app/package.json, which ignores what the destination holds but not the destination itself.
legend.args: The arguments after the destination. {other-ecosystem} stands for a template the other ecosystem's initializer serves.
legend.method: Whether --method mt_case is passed. Defaults to true.
legend.key: Whether PIPELEX_API_KEY is set. Defaults to true.
legend.tools: Which of make and git are on the PATH. Defaults to both.
legend.git_identity: Whether git has an identity to commit with. true: in its global configuration; false: none, and git refuses to guess one; under-parent: only through an includeIf "gitdir:<the destination's parent>/" section, git refusing to guess one elsewhere; enclosing-only: only in the enclosing repository's own .git/config, git refusing to guess one elsewhere. Defaults to true.
legend.make_exit: The stub make's exit status. Defaults to 0.
legend.expect.verdict: The verdict: the last line's first word, or its first two for refused: and failed:.
legend.expect.written: Whether the template was written. When false, the destination holds exactly what it held before the run.
legend.expect.git: initialized: the destination is a repository on main with one commit, the pristine one, and an enclosing repository's HEAD did not move and its git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all prints nothing; first-commit: the repository that was there has one commit, the pristine one; none: the destination holds no .git, and the enclosing repository's HEAD did not move; untouched: the repository that was there did not change.
legend.expect.forwarded: Arguments make's argument vector must contain.
